summary: Microbot Medical Inc. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting an amendment to the employment agreement with CFO Rachel Vaknin, increasing her annual base salary to NIS 864,000 (approximately $288,000 at a 3:1 NIS/USD presumed rate), effective August 1, 2026. The filing is a routine executive compensation arrangement under Item 5.02, with the agreement attached. No special situation such as a merger, tender, or activist action is implicated. This is a standard compensation disclosure, not a special-situation event, so no deal terms or strategic implications are present.
